messages.subject: RStan v2.8.0 is on CRAN!
parts:
RStan v2.8.0 is out now. Most of the improvements for this version come from updates to the Stan Math Library.

For release notes, see the RStan news page: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rstan/NEWS


- Stan Development Team
